title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper RAPTOR: Practical Numerical Profiling of Scientific Applications
problem: Artifact evaluation and reproducibility assessment of RAPTOR numerical profiling framework
motivation: Validation of research artifacts is essential for scientific credibility; SC25 Reproducibility Initiative provides formal evaluation
method: They tested the RAPTOR numerical profiling framework—a tool that monitors how numbers behave during calculations in scientific code—by following the official SC25 Reproducibility Initiative checklist. They obtained the code, examined how it was built, and ran the same experiments as the original paper to check if the reported results matched. They documented what worked, what didn't, and whether independent researchers could reproduce the original findings.
key_novelty: This work independently verifies that RAPTOR's implementation is reproducible and produces the results the original paper claimed.
contributions: Reproducibility assessment of numerical profiling techniques
Validation documentation for scientific computing tools
limitations: Reproducibility reports have limited novelty; focuses on artifact evaluation rather than algorithmic innovation
